description: Kernel-mystery probe: Excel's small-x erf on very long runs of consecutive mantissas (32,768 each) at alias-friendly x, to measure the fine factor's rounding rate to about 0.03% where it changes curvature (z between 3E-4 and 1.5E-3). Runs: x0=0.0322265625 z0=0.00103855 n=32768 row=1; x0=0.0380859375 z0=0.00145054 n=32768 row=32769. B = ERF.PRECISE(x).
